description: This source file defines a final utility class Validator that provides methods for validating query parameter values such as limit, size, and skip, ensuring they meet specific constraints.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Helper class for validation of query parameters, ensuring they are within valid ranges.

methods.name: checkLimit
methods.description: Validates the limit parameter against a maximum, ensuring it respects minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: checkSize
methods.description: Validates the size parameter similarly to checkLimit.

methods.name: checkSkip
methods.description: Validates the skip parameter to ensure it does not exceed the maximum permissible value.

methods.name: checkMinLimit
methods.description: Ensures the limit parameter is at least zero.

methods.name: checkMinSize
methods.description: Ensures the size parameter is at least zero.

methods.name: checkMinSkip
methods.description: Ensures the skip parameter is at least zero.

methods.name: checkMinParamValue
methods.description: Performs the check that a parameter value is >= 0, throws an exception if not.

methods.name: checkMaxSkip
methods.description: Ensures the skip value does not exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE.

methods.name: checkMaxLimit
methods.description: Ensures the limit value does not exceed maxLimit.

methods.name: checkMaxSize
methods.description: Ensures the size value does not exceed maxLimit.

methods.name: checkMaxParamValue
methods.description: Performs the check that a parameter value does not exceed a maximum, throws exception if it does.
